title: Nami Solo
extract:
The Nami Solo is the single cutlass version of the  Nami Skyla.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Sundering Weave,  Cyclone Kraken and  Rending Wind (Conclave only) stance.
Innate  polarity.

Acquisition
The Nami Solo's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Nami Solo Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Nami Solo with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Nami Solo Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Dracroot, and 150  Aggristones.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by building Melee Combo to 6x, then using a Heavy Attack. Once activated, the Incarnon form lasts for 180 seconds.
Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, Incarnon Form is removed upon death.

Evolutions

Trivia
Historically the cutlass was normally used much like a machete, hacking through tough material such as wood or heavy rope. Its durability and size made it an effective weapon in the cramped confines of a ship. This may explain why the Nami Solo is classified as such.
The Codex entry of the Nami Solo uses the stance used to showcase most one-handed weaponry, but its short hilt results in your Warframe's left hand grasping at nothing.
The word Nami (波) means "wave" in Japanese.
